name: Amamikado Kuro
source:
"Let me tell you one good thing. I don't have anything to handle."

The shrine maiden of Kushitsukuyori. he is commonly known as the "Kuro no Miko."

With her meek personality and unrivaled beauty, she is popular in school. She is completely indifferent to things that she isn't interested in.

She dislikes insects and swimming.

[Translated from [url=http://mikatuki.sakura.ne.jp/m/contents/character/img/chara_kuro.png]official website[/url]]
